opening.argument: The speaker presents OneCoin as an investment built around paid gold-mining packages, stating that “The minimum investment is EUR 100” and that each package is supported by gold. The presentation promises that early participants will “get good profits” as prices grow, then adds a partnership program to “earn money,” with a net bonus tied to volume. Finally, the speaker invites viewers into his team. These investment, profit, bonus, and recruitment claims support the alleged paid-return scheme, while the available evidence does not establish whether the promised returns, payment methods, or rewards were fulfilled.
